# eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

Retrieves the EC2 instance types available for restore in a subnet and region of a restore account. Use this data source to select a value for `eon_restore_job` `ec2_config.instance_type`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List EC2 instance types available for restore in a subnet and region
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "demo" {
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  region     = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id  = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
}

output "first_instance_type" {
  description = "First listed EC2 instance type available for restore"
  value       = try(data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types.demo.instance_types[0], null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.
- `region` (String) Region where the subnet is located.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet whose instance types to list.

### Optional

- `total_volume_bytes` (Number) Total size of the guest volumes you plan to restore, in bytes. Used to size the host-memory reserve. If omitted, the server uses a default.
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of guest volumes you plan to restore. Used to size the host-memory reserve for instant-restore host selection. If omitted, the server uses a default.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (List of String) List of EC2 instance types available for restore.
- `instant_restore_mapping` (Map of String) Map from post-promotion to instant-restore host instance type. Options that are present in `instance_types` but absent from this map are not available for instant restore in the availability zone.
